name: 11779 · Ronkonkoma, NY
findings: ZIP 11779 (Ronkonkoma) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11779 (Ronkonkoma) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
